messages.text:
Hi George, hi HeliumDeploy team,

This is urgent! I've tried to reach you several times over the past months,
through the regular channels and directly, without a single reply. We do
receive your marketing emails, but our questions about our own affiliate
account go unanswered.

Our affiliate account was approved on 16 May 2026. Almost six months later,
HeliumDeploy is still not live on our sites, because the account and
dashboard aren't set up correctly. We've been ready to launch for months!

*Timeline*

   - 16 May 2026: account approved, but your approval email was addressed
   to "Myrna J."
   - 18 August, 29 August and 8 September: we had to reset the affiliate
   account password three times
   - 28 September: I emailed you directly with a request and three
   questions. No reply.
   - 13 November: still no reply, still not live

*What's wrong with the account*

   1. *Wrong name.* The account was approved under "Myrna J.", a name
   that has nothing to do with us. Please register the account to Cryptocodes,
   with our correct contact details.
   2. *Wrong coupon code.* Our coupon is ····, generated from
   that same wrong name. We can't publish a code with a stranger's name on our
   sites! Please change it to CRYPTOCODES, with the same 10% off (up to $50
   per item). That's the code our readers know us by and the one we use with
   all our partners.
   3. *Settings and dashboard.* The account settings don't match our
   details. Please check the full profile and all settings on your side.

*Questions still open since 28 September*

   1. How long is the cookie window, and do the link and the coupon both
   count toward our account?
   2. Which commission rate applies to our account? Given our reach, we'd
   like to be on the 8% Partner tier.
   3. Which models ship from your EU warehouse? Almost all our readers are
   in Europe.

*Who we are*

Cryptocodes is a multilingual crypto network with more than 50,000 unique
visitors per month across eight European language editions:

   - cryptocodes.eu
   <https://www.google.com/url?q=http://cryptocodes.eu&source=gmail&ust=1794651161370000&sa=E>
   (English, with language sections)
   - cryptocode.nl
   <https://www.google.com/url?q=http://cryptocode.nl&source=gmail&ust=1794651161370000&sa=E>
   (Dutch)
   - cryptocode.be
   <https://www.google.com/url?q=http://cryptocode.be&source=gmail&ust=1794651161370000&sa=E>
   (Belgium)
   - cryptocode.fr
   <https://www.google.com/url?q=http://cryptocode.fr&source=gmail&ust=1794651161370000&sa=E>
   (French)
   - cryptocode.es
   <https://www.google.com/url?q=http://cryptocode.es&source=gmail&ust=1794651161370000&sa=E>
   (Spanish)
   - cryptocode.pt
   <https://www.google.com/url?q=http://cryptocode.pt&source=gmail&ust=1794651161370000&sa=E>
   (Portuguese)
   - cryptopromo.de
   <https://www.google.com/url?q=http://cryptopromo.de&source=gmail&ust=1794651161370000&sa=E>
   (German)
   - cryptopromo.pl
   <https://www.google.com/url?q=http://cryptopromo.pl&source=gmail&ust=1794651161370000&sa=E>
   (Polish)

We cover home mining, mining hardware, exchanges and MiCA, and we run our
own home mining fleet, so we test hardware hands-on. We work with more than
15 partners across exchanges and mining hardware. Our audience is exactly
the people who buy your miners: European home miners.

*What happens once it's fixed*

As soon as the name and coupon are corrected and the open questions are
answered, HeliumDeploy goes live across all our editions.

*Account details*

   - Affiliate ID: ····
   - Account email: (email hidden)
   - Custom link: heliumdeploy.com/cryptocodes
   <https://www.google.com/url?q=http://heliumdeploy.com/cryptocodes&source=gmail&ust=1794651161370000&sa=E>
   (this part works)
   - Please reply to: (email hidden)

*Deadline*

Please respond by Friday 20 November 2026! If we haven't heard from you by
then, we'll end the partnership. In that case, please treat this email as
our formal request under Article 17 GDPR to:

   - close our affiliate account ····
   - deactivate the link heliumdeploy.com/cryptocodes
   <https://www.google.com/url?q=http://heliumdeploy.com/cryptocodes&source=gmail&ust=1794651161370000&sa=E>
   and the coupon code
   - delete all personal data linked to us, including any customer account
   under (email hidden)
   - complete the deletion within 30 days, by 20 December 2026, and confirm
   it in writing

We'd much rather make this work, and we're ready to go live the moment the
account is fixed.

Best regards,

[image: Cryptocodes] <https://cryptocodes.eu>
Andreas C.
Crypto news, comparisons and MiCA in Europe

Hi Andreas,

Thank you for setting all of this out so clearly. I'm sorry it has taken this long, and that your earlier messages from 28 September went unanswered.

I'm Hal, HeliumDeploy's technical support specialist. I can't change affiliate accounts, coupons or commission rates myself, so I've passed your whole message to Georges and the team. That includes the account name to correct, the coupon you want changed from ···· to CRYPTOCODES at the same 10% off (up to $50 per item), the profile and dashboard review, and your three open questions about the cookie window, your commission rate and the EU warehouse.

I've also marked your deadline of Friday 20 November. The team knows that if they haven't answered by then, this email stands as your formal request under Article 17 GDPR, as you described it.

The team picks this up today at 10am Eastern time. Their answer will come by email, to the address you asked them to reply to.

Best regards,
Hal, HeliumDeploy Technical Support
